editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the IBPS Clerk Preliminary Examination covering English Language, Numerical Ability, and Reasoning Ability within a sixty-minute time limit.
editorial.overview: The IBPS Clerk Preliminary Examination is administered by IBPS and carefully evaluates candidates across three distinct test domains within a strict sixty-minute timeframe. It features a total of one hundred questions constructed specifically to measure candidate proficiency and capability across core competency areas required for prospective banking clerk roles in various institutions.
editorial.who_should_take: Candidates seeking banking roles who want to demonstrate standard skills in language, mathematics, and logic should take this exam. It serves as the preliminary stage for aspiring bank clerks.
editorial.preparation_strategy: To prepare successfully, practice sample problems across all three subject domains regularly every single week without fail. Focus heavily on managing your time effectively to successfully complete all one hundred questions within the sixty-minute testing limit. Review core concepts in English, arithmetic, and reasoning daily.

domain_guidance.summary: This specific domain measures your command of the English Language, assessing reading comprehension abilities, grammatical rules, and vocabulary skills required for effective professional communication within modern banking institutions.
study_focus: Practice reading comprehension and vocabulary exercises
Review grammar rules and sentence correction
Take practice tests on verbal sections

domain_guidance.summary: This specific domain tests Numerical Ability, covering simplification exercises, number series sequences, and general arithmetic calculations relevant to performing quantitative tasks accurately and efficiently under strict time pressure.
study_focus: Practice number series and arithmetic word problems

domain_guidance.summary: This specific domain evaluates Reasoning Ability through logical inequalities, syllogism rules, alphabet tests, number tests, and complex logical puzzles designed to test analytical thinking capabilities and logical deduction skills.
study_focus: Solve alphabet tests, number tests, and logical puzzles

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Arrive at the designated testing center early with your required identification documents. Manage your time carefully across the 100 questions to ensure completion within the 60-minute duration.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: There are exactly 100 total questions distributed across 3 distinct subject domains on the IBPS Clerk Preliminary Examination, which must all be completed within 60 minutes.
Passing score criteria and cut-offs are determined directly by IBPS based on overall test performance and available vacancies. Check with IBPS for specific score requirements.

The official examination duration is precisely sixty minutes for all one hundred questions across the English Language, Numerical Ability, and Reasoning Ability subject domains during your test attempt.
The exam price is ₹850 or approximately $10 USD for general candidates, and ₹175 or approximately $2 USD for SC, ST, PwBD, and Ex-Servicemen candidates.

methodology.summary: This informational page was constructed using official IBPS documentation and exam guidance details to provide accurate subject requirements and structural facts for prospective candidates.
